job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Title: Project Manager - Network & Security
Day Rate: £450 per day - Outside IR35 / Limited Company
Duration: 6 months initially
Location: Central London, near Bank Station - Fully onsite
Start Date: ASAP

Overview
We are assisting a client in their requirement for an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of a Cisco network and security transformation programme.

As Project Manager, you will take ownership of the end-to-end delivery, coordinating technical resources, stakeholders, third parties and business teams to ensure the migration is delivered successfully with minimal disruption to production services.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and manage the project from initiation through design, build, migration, testing, cutover and handover into BAU.
  • Develop and maintain the overall project plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID log and delivery schedule.
  • Coordinate the deployment of the new Cisco Secure Firewall infrastructure, including FMC HA and multiple firewall HA pairs.
  • Manage the programme of legacy firewall configuration and policy migration, ensuring appropriate technical review, testing and sign-off.
  • Coordinate the migration of Cisco Catalyst 3850 switch stacks to Catalyst 9300 infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Network/Security Consultants, Architects and operational teams to ensure technical deliverables are completed to agreed timescales.
  • Plan and coordinate production change windows, migrations and cutovers, including rollback planning and business communications.
  • Manage dependencies between firewall, routing/BGP, switching and associated infrastructure changes.
  • Ensure appropriate HLD/LLD, implementation plans, migration plans, test plans, rollback plans and operational handover documentation are produced and approved.
  • Manage technical and business risks, issues, actions and dependencies through to resolution.
  • Coordinate CAB/change-management submissions and approvals where required.
  • Provide clear project reporting to technical and senior stakeholders, including progress, risks, milestones and financial/resource position.
  • Manage third-party suppliers and vendors where required.
  • Ensure successful transition into operational support following implementation.
Required Experience
  • Strong experience delivering enterprise network and/or network security infrastructure projects.
  • Previous delivery experience involving firewall deployments, upgrades or migrations.
  • Experience managing projects involving Cisco networking and security technologies would be highly desirable.
  • Experience managing network switch refresh/migration programmes, ideally involving Cisco Catalyst infrastructure.
  • Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts including routing, BGP, switching, high availability, firewalls and network security.
  • Experience managing complex infrastructure migrations within live production environments.
  • Strong understanding of change management, implementation planning, testing, cutover and rollback processes.
  • Proven experience coordinating Network Engineers, Security Engineers, Consultants and Architects.
  • Strong RAID, dependency and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Experience managing third-party suppliers and multiple technical workstreams.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical delivery issues into clear business impact and project risk.
Desirable
  • Experience delivering projects involving Cisco Secure Firewall / Firepower / FTD / FMC.
  • Exposure to Cisco Catalyst 3850 and 9300 environments.
  • Experience delivering projects involving BGP/routing changes alongside firewall migrations.
  • Cisco infrastructure transformation or data centre/network refresh experience.
  • Relevant project management certification such as PRINCE2, PMP, AgilePM or equivalent.

job.title: Information Security Cloud Architect
job.description:
Job Title: Information Security Cloud Consultant / Architect - AWS & Azure
Day Rate: £600 per day - Outside IR35 / Limited Company
Duration: 3+ months
Based: Hybrid - Liverpool 
Start Date: ASAP
 
Role
We are seeking an experienced Information Security Cloud Consultant / Architect for an initial 3 month engagement, supporting the design, assurance and implementation of secure multi-cloud environments across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
 
The role will provide specialist security architecture consultancy and independent design assurance for new cloud-based services and solutions, including cloud environments supporting the client's developing AI strategy, AI services and data platforms.
 
Responsibilities
  • Provide security architecture consultancy across AWS and Azure projects.
  • Review and assure cloud solution designs against security standards, policies and architecture principles.
  • Develop secure reference architectures, patterns and guardrails for multi-cloud environments.
  • Support the secure design of environments for AI services, data platforms, experimentation and production AI workloads.
  • Conduct security design reviews across cloud applications, services and infrastructure.
  • Identify security risks and provide practical, proportionate remediation recommendations.
  • Embed security-by-design principles throughout project delivery.
  • Ensure effective integration between cloud-native security services and existing enterprise security capabilities.
  • Produce clear security architecture, assurance and governance outputs.
  • Work closely with enterprise architects, cloud engineers, project teams, third-party suppliers and managed service providers.
Experience
  • Strong Cloud Security Architecture experience within complex enterprise environments.
  • In-depth security experience across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Multi-cloud security architecture, controls, patterns and guardrails.
  • Cloud IAM, network security, data protection, encryption, logging and monitoring.
  • Cloud-native security tooling and enterprise security integration.
  • Security architecture and assurance for cloud-hosted applications and infrastructure.
  • Strong security risk assessment and remediation experience.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and senior stakeholders.
Desirable
  • Security architecture experience supporting AI/ML platforms and services.
  • Securing AI workloads, data platforms and AI data pipelines.
  • AWS and Azure AI services.
  • Cisco enterprise security technologies.
  • Zero Trust architecture and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Security, Azure Security, CISSP, CCSP or SABSA.

job.title: SailPoint Technical Consultant
job.description:
Job title: SailPoint Technical Consultant
Day rate: £450 per day - Outside IR35 / Limited Company
Duration: 6 months
Location: Fully remote / WFH
Start date: ASAP

Role
We are seeking an experienced SailPoint Technical Consultant to lead the technical delivery of a SailPoint implementation (IGA) within a complex enterprise security environment.
 
This is a hands-on delivery role requiring deep expertise in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and/or IdentityIQ (IIQ). The successful applicant will work closely with the client's CISO, security stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to review and understand the existing solution design, then lead the configuration, integration and deployment of the platform.
 
Responsibilities
  • Review and validate the existing SailPoint solution design, deployment scope, technical dependencies and target architecture
  • Implement the agreed SailPoint solution, recommending and applying technical refinements where required
  • Lead the hands-on configuration, integration, and deployment of SailPoint, including integration with Microsoft Entra ID, identity sources, enterprise applications, and target systems
  • Configure core identity governance capabilities, including Joiner, Mover and Leaver (JML) processes, access requests, provisioning, roles, entitlements, access certifications, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls
  • Troubleshoot and resolve identity, provisioning, connector, configuration, and data issues throughout delivery
  • Support testing, production readiness, go-live, and post-deployment stabilisation
  • Produce technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge transfer to ensure a successful handover
Required Experience
  • Recent hands-on experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and/or IdentityIQ (IIQ)
  • Experience implementing and delivering SailPoint solutions through configuration, integration, testing and go-live
  • Deep understanding of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) principles and best practices
  • Practical experience configuring: SailPoint connectors, APIs, Workflows, Provisioning 
  • Identity lifecycle processes
  • Experience integrating SailPoint with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and enterprise applications.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across: Identity data, Access models, Provisioning, Connectors, Downstream systems
  • Ability to work independently while identifying delivery risks early and recommending pragmatic solutions
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with senior security leaders, architects, and technical teams
Desirable
  • SailPoint certification (IdentityIQ and/or Identity Security Cloud)
  • Experience within regulated or security-sensitive environments
  • Experience recovering or de-risking complex identity programmes
  • Familiarity with audit, compliance, and formal security governance frameworks
  • Experience working within blended client and professional services delivery teams

Job title: Data Cabling Engineer 
Location: Chichester, Sussex
Duration: 2-4 weeks initially
Day rate: £200 per day (day shift) / £260 per day (evening shift) - CIS, Limited Company or PAYE (contractor can choose)

Role
We are assisting a successful company who specialise in the installation of copper and fibre network cabling, and they are assembling a small team of experienced data cabling engineers to work in Chichester, Sussex for one of their prestigious clients.  As Data Cabling Engineer, you will be responsible for copper and fibre cable pulling and copper terminations.
 
Essential requirements
  • Previous experience operating as a Data Cabling Engineer
  • Copper & fibre installation experience
  • Good understanding of health and safety practice, supported with a CSCS or ECS card

  • Able to work in a team
  • An energetic work ethic, focused on a positive and timely outcome
  • Able to work in England without requiring sponsorship or the processing of a work visa

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job title: Network Engineer - SONiC / Advanced Networking
Day rate: £400-450 per day - Outside IR35 / Limited Company
Start date: Immediate
Duration: TBC - multiple projects
Location: Fully remote

Overview
We are looking for an experienced Network Engineer to provide specialist network engineering. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud), advanced networking technologies and BGP routing.

Experience with Celestica SONiC is highly desirable; however, candidates with experience of other enterprise or community SONiC distributions will also be considered.

  • Configure and support SONiC based networking environments
  • Troubleshoot and optimise Layer 2 and Layer 3 network infrastructure
  • Configure and support BGP routing
  • Support Software VPN implementations
  • Diagnose and resolve network issues in a fast-paced project environment
Essential Skills
  • Hands-on experience with SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud)
  • Strong understanding of advanced networking principles
  • Proven experience configuring and troubleshooting BGP
  • Experience with Software VPN technologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision
Desirable Skills
  • Experience with Celestica SONiC
  • Experience with Dell Enterprise SONiC or other enterprise/community SONiC distributions
